settings.title: 6 Pentatonic Notes: Always Harmonic, Never Out of Tune
Everything You Need for Pocket Peace & Garden Ambiance

settings.question: Can I leave the Zavelyn Rain Drum™ outside in the rain?
settings.answer: Yes! The drum is coated with an electrostatic baked outdoor powder finish designed specifically to withstand rain, humidity, UV sunlight, and temperature shifts without rusting or tarnishing.

settings.question: Does rain actually play the drum on its own?
settings.answer: Yes! When placed in an open garden, patio, or beneath rain gutters, falling raindrops strike the curved alloy tongues to trigger soft, natural chime melodies automatically.

settings.question: What scale are the 6 notes tuned to?
settings.answer: The Zavelyn Rain Drum™ is tuned to a pure Pentatonic harmony scale across 6 numbered tongues. The pentatonic layout contains no dissonant intervals, meaning every sequence of notes naturally sounds sweet and relaxing.

settings.question: What is included with the drum?
settings.answer: Every Zavelyn Rain Drum™ includes the 3-inch 6-tone steel drum, a solid wooden mallet with a soft rubber resonator tip, pre-applied numbered decals, and a protective pouch.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 90-Day Money-Back Guarantee. If the Rain Drum doesn't bring peace and joy to your home or garden, return it for a 100% full refund with no hassle.
